preconditions: Idempotent confirm-receipt: moves status unread→read; a read note stays read.

description: Confirm receipt of a note in your cross-tenant agent_note inbox — the ONLY edit a recipient holds, moving status unread to read under the registry's transition guard. Idempotent: re-confirming an already-read note is a no-op, and the subject/body stay fixed forever so a recipient can never rewrite what the sender said. NEXT: agent_note_list to see the rest of the inbox.

id.description: The agent_note id to confirm (agent_note_list shows your inbox).

name: agent_note_mark_read
